headline: Trump Says IRAN WAR 🛡️ Won't END ⏹️ Until AFTER 🕒 Midterms 📅
text:
US President Donald Trump 🍊 has DROPPED 💣 the BOMBSHELL 🧨 that this IRAN war ⚔️ won't wrap up 🎁 until AFTER November's midterm elections 🗳️ adding that oil prices 🛢️ will NOT come down 📉 until then 🤝. "I think the war's going to end immediately after the election 🗳️ because they can't hold out any longer 🕰️" Trump said of Iran's leaders 🇮🇷 on Wednesday 🗓️. He made the comments as he headed 🚗 to Texas 🤠 for the Republican Party's first midterm election convention 🎉 and repeated them there 🗣️ arguing that short-term economic pain 😣 was worth it 💰 to prevent Iran from developing nuclear weapons ☢️. Trump is facing falling polling numbers 📊 and pressure from within his party 🐘 to end the war ⚔️ which began when the US 🇺🇸 and Israel 🇮🇱 attacked Iran in February ❄️.

The conflict rapidly spread 🌍 across the Middle East 🕌 as Iran retaliated by launching missiles 🚀 and drones 🛸 at Israel 🇮🇱 and Arab states 🏜️ hosting US military facilities 🛠️. The price of Brent crude oil 🛢️ the global benchmark 📈 has risen above the $100 mark 💵 three times over the past six months 🗓️ with Iranian attacks forcing production stoppages 🛑 in Gulf states 🌊 and disrupting exports through the vital Strait of Hormuz waterway 🚢. The US has also imposed a naval blockade 🚫 on Iran's ports ⚓ and has recently begun striking Iranian tankers 🚤 in response to attacks on warships 🛳️ and other vessels 🛥️. "Right after the election 🗳️ oil prices are going to be tumbling downward 📉" Trump told reporters 🗣️. "I think it's going to take a little bit longer than the midterm 📅" he added that Iran was "desperate to try and affect the election 🗳️ so that we can get a nice weak group of people in there 👥" an apparent reference to the Democrats 🐴 "and leave them alone and let them have their nuclear weapon ☢️".

He provided no proof 📜 of the election claim 🗳️ Tehran has repeatedly denied it is seeking nuclear weapons ☢️ and insisted its nuclear programme is solely peaceful 🕊️. At the convention in Texas 🤠 Trump echoed some of these lines 🗣️ saying the price of oil would tumble 📉 "as soon as we win the war with Iran ⚔️". In his speech 🎤 he also referenced dissatisfaction among some Americans 🇺🇸 on the issue: "Guys come up to me and say 🗣️ 'I wish you didn't do the war in Iran ⚔️ Now gasoline is up ⛽'". Trump also said further negotiations with Iran could possibly happen 🤝 "but it's not something we're looking at" 👀. The US president initially predicted the war ⚔️ which is now in its seventh month 🗓️ would last only a matter of weeks ⏳.

The conflict ⚔️ and its knock-on effects on everything from fuel ⛽ to groceries 🛒 has led to a steep decline in his approval ratings 📉 and pressure from those within his party 🐘 including staunch supporters to quickly end the war 🏁. Midterm elections will be held on 3 November 🗳️ and Republicans are in danger of losing control on Congress 🏛️. At the convention 🤠 Trump sought to energise the party ahead of November 🏃‍♂️. Historically a sitting president's party tends to lose seats in Congress 🪑 in the midterm elections 📅. Fighting in the Middle East 🕌 has intensified in recent days 🌡️ as oil facilities throughout the region come under attack 💥 driving up the global price of fuel ⛽ and other goods that require shipping 📦.

The price of oil hit $100 a barrel 🛢️ on Wednesday for the first time since July ☀️. Similarly earlier this week the price of US diesel hit an all-time high 🏆 which is likely to cause a ripple effect on prices across the US 🌊. There are also predictions that the rising fuel costs could lead to higher interest rates 📈. On Tuesday night the US military said it had attacked and destroyed five oil tankers 🚤 with ties to Iran's Islamic Revolution Guard Corps in the Gulf of Oman 🌊 and the northern Gulf. The IRGC in response said early on Wednesday that its naval forces had attacked two US Navy destroyers 🛳️ and eight oil tankers 🚢 in the Strait of Hormuz causing "heavy damage" to the vessels 🛠️. Centcom denied its warships were hit 🚫.

The IRGC also said it had launched ballistic missiles 🚀 at US military maintenance facilities 🛠️ hangars � hangar and aircraft ✈️ at Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan 🇯🇴. Jordan's armed forces said they intercepted 20 Iranian missiles 🛡️ and that two other missiles fell in unpopulated areas with no casualties reported 🚫. Later on Wednesday sources told CBS News that several US fighter jets ✈️ at the air base were damaged in the Iranian strikes 💥. One A-10 Thunderbolt aircraft was hit and was missing a wing 🦅 and about eight F-15s sustained light damage according to people familiar with the matter 🧐. Explosions were reported in southern Iran on Wednesday night 💥 but Iranian official sources denied they were US strikes saying the sounds came from the sea 🌊. In a separate development on Tuesday the Iran-backed Houthi movement in Yemen launched a wave of missile and drone attacks 🚀 on south-western Saudi Arabia the world's largest oil exporter causing fires at several oil facilities 🔥.
